Training is more fun now!!! You just have to take a photo of the wall where the boulder you created is located, mark the holds and graduate it. Then just by saving it, it will be added to the list of problems on that wall and voila ... we can all enjoy it.

Also accessing your profile you can keep track of your achievements and pending problems, so that the next time you go to train you can try again.

There are no excuses ... let's train!
